text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New members were steadily joining the team.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Guess what?
I just came up with an awesome team name!
choice_data_list: What kind of name is it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, it sounds super delicious and happy! The name is—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What was it again?
It was jiggly, sweet, and jiggly...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm starting to get kinda hungry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she never remembered, but
Haru Urara left the Trainer's room
in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what do you think~?
It's all jiggly, sweet, and looks delicious, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should consider
the team name they suggested!
